title: Hanging brazier

infobox.Crafting Materials: Bronze x5, Coal x2, Chain x1
infobox.Other Effect(s): Produces smoke, Removes the Cold Effect, Adds the Fire Effect, Rapidly removes the Wet Effect, Reduces Freezing Effect to Cold Effect
infobox.Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Lightning

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Hanging brazier is a light source that can be placed on the underside of a surface, and must be built within the range of a Forge.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
The Hanging brazier has all the same functions as a Campfire and is a base structure.
Hanging braziers are fueled with Coal. With 1/5 fuel, a Hanging brazier will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, a Hanging brazier should burn for 27 hours and 47 minutes. It can be used for cooking, however, it does not fit easily like a Campfire does.
Hanging 2–6 meters off the ground (measuring from where the chain connects), the Fire Effect extends out 9 meters. The horizontal distance begins to drop off if hanging from 7 meters high or higher.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If part of its supporting structure is destroyed, it will not collapse as long as there is another structure that is connected to the ground within ~1 meter of the brazier.
• Destroying the Hanging brazier with a Hammer will not yield back any Coal and will only return the 5 Bronze and 1 Chain used for its construction. All Coal used as fuel and for the initial construction will not be dropped.
• Hanging braziers stop working if exposed to rainy weather without a roof.
